question: What did Paul say when told he had insulted God's high priest?
options: He said the high priest deserved it
He said he did not care
He did not realize he was the high priest, for Scripture says not to speak evil about the ruler of your people
He said Rome was his only ruler
explanation: Paul said he did not realize he was the high priest, for it is written, 'Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.'
